contentText:
Ariana Grande, Bruno Mars, Tame Impala and JENNIE’s “Dracula,” and Ella Langley and Morgan Wallen all move up in the top 10 of the Hot 100, but will any of their songs take over No. 1 from Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas”?

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 for the week dated July 18. “Man I Need” drops to No. 10, while Olivia’s “So Easy” is up to nine. Drake slips to No. 8. “I Just Might” is up to seven, as is Ariana to No. 6. “Dracula” rising to a new No. 5 peak, and Ella and Morgan up to four. Ella’s “Be Her” is still at three, while Taylor Swift is locked at two. So grabbing a 13th week at No. 1 is “Choosin’ Texas.”
